scope: Finite ordinary source/AST and proposed protocol/SOURCE_REVIEW comparison; these scripts were not executed. No current-run read, HF import, tests, science or scientific/media payload access.

checks.parent: Prior successful accepted1/global4/d1.0; ordinary protocol controls parent result and selected index.
checks.actual_N: Derived from len(result.states); originals filtered only for requested targets, retaining all bisection rows. No fixed actualN.
checks.missing_and_partial: Missing helper/result remains None where recorded; outcome pass requires outer and helper pass. Missing saved result is not zero; partial result rows retain status, original failures and unavailable observations. No generated execution PASS from missing records.
checks.success_guards: Require success, cached original gates, endpoint1.15, current settings, anchor SHA/R, newpeak+segment true and full/tasktarget false. No new physics gate or inherited HP qualification.
checks.seals: Only original helper-window SHA/size identities are used for scientific/media suffixes; publication and restore stat these payloads, without rereading or rehashing. A missing required original seal intentionally blocks publication rather than inventing identity.
checks.fronts: All seven inherited fronts read from BASE via git show and prepended; exact old raw suffix is checked once, independently rechecked by publisher.
checks.manifest: 21730 inherited entries observed at review. Publisher obtains inherited count dynamically and only updates seven fronts/newstage then manifest; archive step adds one ordinary receipt.
checks.publication: Normal main commit/push and independent clean-clone fast-forward, delta ordinary SHA checks, scientific/media stat plus inherited seal. No new HF default files, science invocation, full replay or fresh numerical qualification claimed.
checks.archive: Only completed publication receipt and manifest appended in a second ordinary commit; exact two-file delta and independent restore required.
checks.future_next_and_pixels: Next-target selection and pixel QA are actual-result dependent; not supplied or approved by this static review.

limitations: This is not execution or authorization of publication; root owns the later actual close/publish steps.
Known unsealed partial scientific files cannot pass the publisher seal gate; preserve originals and stop for explicit handling instead of recomputing closed-window identity.
No review of current science results or images was performed.
